hypothesis: Trade transient relative-price dislocations while allowing a permanent component of the spread; require model-implied convergence to exceed transaction and carrying costs.
universe: 16 fixed ETF pairs (32 tickers) chosen by related economic exposure, not ranked on returns; data/universe.json. Surviving, currently available fund sample, not a complete point-in-time ETF universe.
data: Yahoo daily split-adjusted OHLCV, adjusted close for signals, split-adjusted distributions for portfolio cash flows; source payloads and checksums retained. No bid-ask/locate data.

periods.locked_evaluation: 2022-2026-09-30, not inspected until implementation and rules frozen

refits: Quarterly; hedge ratio, OU and partial-cointegration parameters estimated using only previous504 sessions; causal Kalman filtering within each quarter.
hedge: OLS log adjusted-close beta, [.5,2]; no name overlaps between predefined pairs; split-adjusted units fixed between entry and exit
cost_gate: Expected log-spread convergence divided by (1+beta) >1.5*(20bp round-trip + expected1% short borrow + risk-free opportunity cost on long leg over20 sessions); direction-aware leg costs. Baseline has no expected-edge gate.
PCI: Residual=M+R, M is stationary AR1, R is a random walk; Gaussian state-space MLE with two initial seeds. Fixed formation OLS hedge ratio; not a literal replication of joint-estimation partialCI. Require converged optimisation and daily-innovation MR variance fraction >=.5.
execution: Close-t signals execute open-t+1. Portfolio daily mark-to-market, distributions on ex-date as receivables; no same-close fills. Scheduled quarter-end liquidation at last open. Full daily/trade/parameter logs.
cost_scenarios: 5/10/20bp each one-way dollar traded, base borrow1%/yr and stress3%/5%; cost gate remains fixed at10bp scenario. Free unencumbered cash earns Fama-French RF; short collateral earns no rebate; no leverage.
selection: No hyperparameter search on locked evaluation. Compare all predeclared models; report failure and no-trade outcomes. Any later revisions must be labelled exploratory.
reporting: Gross/net excess Sharpe, CAGR, drawdown, turnover, holding times, trades, exposure, yearly and pair contribution, block-bootstrap uncertainty, factor exposures and cost sensitivity; separate measured performance from implementation assumptions.
PCI_uncertainty_margin: Subtract one posterior standard deviation of the transient state from its absolute magnitude before evaluating expected convergence. This excludes parameter uncertainty and is not labelled a confidence guarantee.
